_README.purpose: Adversary item ActiveEffects, baked into the edha-adversaries pack by foundry-build.js (adversaries scope). Keyed adversary name -> item name -> [effects]. Extracted 2026-06-11 from the live edha world actors (the 8b hand-built effects), so pack re-imports now KEEP them. Conventions: transfer:true + disabled:true = conditional mode (toggle on the actor), transfer:false = apply-to-target template (drag onto the victim sheet), statuses = token icon.
_README.fields: name, img, disabled, transfer, statuses[], changes[{key,mode,value}] (mode 2=ADD, 5=OVERRIDE), description.

Veil.name: Veil — Concealed (cover/low light)
Veil.description: Toggle while in cover or low light: noticing or attacking the Stalker requires a DC 15 Perception test.

Fade.name: Fade — Concealed (until end of next turn)
Fade.description: Toggle on when Fade triggers (attack grazes or misses, 1 Investiture): Concealed until the end of the Stalker's next turn.

Calc Strike.name: Calc Strike — +3 to one test this round
Calc Strike.description: Apply to the chosen ally: +3 to one test it makes this round (add to the roll).

Probability Net.name: Probability Net — −1d6 to next test
Probability Net.description: Apply to the chosen creature: −1d6 to its next test before the end of its next turn (subtract from the roll).

Glimpse the Path.name: Glimpse the Path — Advantage on all rolls
Glimpse the Path.description: Toggle on when used: the Frostbinder makes all rolls with an advantage until the end of its next turn.

Predictive Ward.name: Predictive Ward — Attacks against have 1 disadvantage
Predictive Ward.description: Passive reminder: all attacks against the Frostbinder are made with 1 disadvantage.

Frost Lance.name: Slowed (Frost Lance, 1 round)
Frost Lance.description: Apply to the target on a hit: Slowed until the end of its next turn.

Brace.name: Brace — Attacks against have 1 disadvantage
Brace.description: Toggle on when used (1 Focus): attacks against the Trooper have 1 disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

Mutation Upgrade.name: Afflicted (Venom — 2 Vital/turn)
Mutation Upgrade.description: Apply to a creature hit by a Venom Glands Slam: it takes 2 Vital at the start of each of its turns.

Mutation Upgrade.name: Venom Glands — Slam inflicts Afflicted
Mutation Upgrade.description: Toggle on when granted by the Stitchmother: Slam inflicts Afflicted (2 Vital/turn) on a hit.

Mutation Upgrade.name: Bone Spurs — Slam +2 Keen
Mutation Upgrade.description: Toggle on when granted by the Stitchmother: Slam deals +2 Keen damage (add to the damage roll).

Vital Diagram.name: Vital Diagram — Marked (+4 Vital taken, Deflect bypassed)
Vital Diagram.description: Drag onto the marked PC: until the end of the scene, hits against it deal +4 Vital (add to damage) and bypass its Deflect (this effect sets Deflect to 0).

Phase 2.name: Phase 2 — Transformed
Phase 2.description: Toggle on the first time the Stitchmother drops below 70 HP: +20 max HP (then set HP to 90), +1 STR, +1 SPD, attacks deal +2 Vital (add manually), regenerates 2d6 at the start of each turn, free Scalpel-Strike when it heals a creature adjacent to its target.

Suture Cradle.name: Suture Cradle — Cradled (sustained)
Suture Cradle.description: Apply to the healed target as a reminder. Sustained: 1 Investiture at the start of the Stitchmother's turns; when the target is hit, Discipline test DC 10 + damage taken or the cradle ends.

Bite.name: Bite — Target sheds light (1 round)
Bite.description: Apply to the target on a hit: it sheds light (as a torch) until the end of its next turn.

Cinder Coat.name: Cinder Coat — Melee attackers take 1d4 Energy
Cinder Coat.description: Passive reminder: when a melee attack hits the Cinderhound, the attacker takes 1d4 Energy splash damage.

Brace.name: Brace — Attacks against have 2 disadvantage
Brace.description: Toggle on when used (1 Focus): attacks against the Captain have 2 disadvantage until the start of its next turn.
